description: Documented, reviewed signature equivalences between upstream TypeScript functions and their Python ports. Entries are exempt from the arity check because the Python API is a deliberate, behaviour-preserving adaptation; every entry must carry a concrete reason.

categories.options-object: TypeScript takes one options/input object; Python exposes the same fields as explicit parameters (Pythonic keyword API).
categories.context-object: TypeScript passes several context arguments; Python bundles them into one adapter/context object.

entries.name: composeUserPrompt
entries.reason: Upstream input is {prompt, image?, ...}; Python takes the destructured fields directly.

entries.name: prepareModelImage
entries.reason: Upstream input is {imageBase64,width,height,policy}; Python takes those fields as parameters.

entries.name: resolveLocate
entries.reason: Upstream locate definition plus resolved planner/protocol context; Python reads them from the ModelAdapter instance.
